attempts.finalSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS damaging_variants,
  SUM(CASE WHEN clinical_significance = 'PATHOGENIC' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pathogenic_variants,
  SUM(CASE WHEN clinical_significance = 'LIKELY_PATHOGENIC' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS likely_pathogenic_variants
FROM world_cup.genomics.variants
WHERE clinical_significance IN ('PATHOGENIC','LIKELY_PATHOGENIC');
